description: Home model annotations and preserved migration coordinates. This file is documentation for domain alignment; schema-admin does not read or enforce it.

vocabulary_policy.closed: Only the listed options; domain commands do not extend or delete them.
vocabulary_policy.seeded: Initial options may be extended after explicit validation; domain commands do not delete options.
vocabulary_policy.open: No seed; a new dictated value may create an option during the domain operation.

zone.note: The collection-layout type requires an app/experience setup path; creating its objects is a separate operation.

point.note: Accepted 17-property order for the reviewed connection/control cases. Manufacturer, model and manual describe the fitting itself. Templates select the relevant subset. Two independently wired RJ45 terminations are two Points even on one faceplate; outlet_count remains available.

circuit.note: A physical departure and its run. Rating, dedicated RCD and panel position describe LV breaker departures, not relay modules.

device.note: Includes plugged-in and permanently wired equipment. One physical bulb is one Device, linked directly to its Point; shared model data must not duplicate a serial. System grouping is optional; quantity remains available for other equipment.

component.note: System membership remains required. Removing that requirement for a dismantled part has not been accepted.

idea.note: The body is the idea; the first line supplies its display name. Pinned alone, outside the five sections.

todo.note: Native done marks completion. Task/worksite multi-attachment behavior and the proposed create/update asymmetry remain to be settled.

category.note: Legacy v4 vocabulary retained pending a complete replacement decision. Hardwired equipment is now a Device; old equipment-named Point categories are not instructions for new classification. PC covers heater/shutter cable outlets; LC/LW/LS, CS and the simple AR relay remain. LR, CP and assemblies are deferred.

control_link.note: Links actually used to control equipment; multiple values are possible. Supported protocols are a separate fact.

pipe.note: Seed intentionally empty until the water-circuit review.

earthed.note: Yes and No are explicit observations; an empty value means unknown.

dcl.note: Yes and No are explicit observations; an empty value means unknown.

bulb_base.note: Extensible standard vocabulary, separate from the computing socket property.

lighting_capabilities.extension_policy_note: Initial values are accepted; the policy for adding further options has not been settled.
lighting_capabilities.note: CCT means adjustable white. No Fixed White tag; missing tags do not establish fixed white.

supported_protocols.extension_policy_note: Initial values are accepted; the policy for adding further options has not been settled.
supported_protocols.note: Protocols supported by the Device, whether installed or stored.

connected_to.note: Device connection to one or more physical Points. Storage-only or battery equipment may have no connection. No direct Device-to-Circuit shortcut.

controls.note: Targets the actual controlled Point or Device. Circuit membership and control are separate relations.

circuit.note: Multiple Circuit values are possible on a Point. A legally unconnected Point can leave this relation empty.

upstream_panel.note: Immediate parent Panel; a root leaves this empty. Cross-medium power feeds are ordinary Circuits, not hierarchy links.

part_of.note: Required for Component, optional for Device. The removed-component proposal remains unresolved.

rated_input_power.note: Documented nominal absorbed power only; not an instantaneous measurement, peak, or audio output rating.

rated_output_power.note: Documented nominal electrical output power. Defined but not attached to a type until the supply/assembly classification is settled.

color_temperature_min.note: Documented lower bound; equals the upper bound for documented fixed-white equipment.

color_temperature_max.note: Documented upper bound; equals the lower bound for documented fixed-white equipment.

luminous_flux.note: Keep a documented flux value with its reference temperature. No universal temperature is assumed. Additional documented conditions belong in the body.

migration.status: Historical coordinates, preserved unchanged. Not executable conversion rules; the final clean-key and experience strategy is unresolved.
migration.power_split: The historical power -> power_watts entry refers to the old ambiguous quantity. Neither old value is automatically assignable to rated_input_power or rated_output_power; interpret each preserved value from its evidence.
migration.format_changes: earthed and dcl change from checkbox to select; control_link changes from select to multi_select. Preserve source values and unknowns before any live conversion.
migration.key_collisions: Anytype built-in keys deliberately avoided: `project` (type), `status`, `due_date`, `description` (properties) — hence `state` for Statut and `target_date` for Date cible. Arbitrated on the 2026-08-10 fresh space, to re-verify at preview on the new one: `task` is a built-in type (Task, action layout) — fallback applies, type key `todo`, label 'Tâche' unchanged; `exposure` is a built-in property (Camera exposure, text) — plant property is `plant_exposure`, label 'Exposition'. A type key CAN coexist with a same-key property (verified live 2026-07-21): point/circuit/panel/worksite property keys are safe. The Gestion keys (priority, depends_on, estimated_budget, actual_budget, estimated_effort, actual_effort, definition_of_done, related_tasks) matched no built-in on the previous space; preview will confirm on the new one.
